inputs.text: Epic deep-space flagship flying diagonally upward from the lower-left foreground, a massive interstellar battleship built from layered armor plates, luminous engines, intricate believable mechanical detail, a monumental command bridge; two smaller escort vessels receding in the distance. Vast violet-and-blue nebula, dense stars, and a sunlit ringed planet behind it. Cool cyan engine glow and golden rim light sweep across the hull. Photorealistic hard-science-fiction cinematic concept art, monumental scale, crisp focus, razor-sharp spacecraft structures, high micro-detail, clean atmospheric depth, 16:9 horizontal composition, no people, no lettering, no watermark.
